source: Explicit owner corrections for the identified photographs. No identities inferred from facial resemblance.

photoCorrections.name: Ramona Macho
photoCorrections.evidence: Owner identified Ramona as the person with the pink umbrella.
photoCorrections.description: Tre personer i kostumer; den ene har lange, mørke stoffrynser omkring hovedet. Dennis har brun kjole og håret skjult af kostumet. Ramona Macho står med en lyserød paraply. På billedet ses også Puta.
photoCorrections.english: Three people in costume; one has long, dark fabric fringes around the head. Dennis wears a brown dress and his hair is hidden by the costume. Ramona Macho is holding a pink umbrella. Puta is also pictured.
